comment: Parameters of the privileged reference program. Every number has its source in 'provenance'.

provenance.limits.lateral_frac_of_grip_g: the drive model's calibration table, cone tyre: steady-state maximum lateral acceleration 0.974-0.977 of grip x g at grip 0.45-1.0
provenance.limits.brake_frac_of_grip_g: the drive model's calibration table: full braking 0.995-1.005 of grip x g
provenance.limits.traction_frac_of_grip_g: The reference program's probe accel_curve.py on the drive model's car (speed target ramped 0.3-1.2 m/s ahead): 0.96-1.0 of grip x g below 3 m/s at grip 1.0 / 0.675 / 0.5; 0.95 taken
provenance.limits.speed_cap_mps: the drive model's top speed 6.3251 m/s (grip 1.0, command 8 m/s); the plan stays below it so the speed loop is never saturated on a straight
provenance.limits.motor_accel_table_grip1: The reference program's probe motor_envelope.py on the drive model's car: speed target 1.2 m/s ahead of the speed, grip 1.0, acceleration of the smoothed speed, every 0.25 m/s
provenance.limits.motor_accel_use_frac: The reference program's choice: the profile asks for 90 % of the measured envelope so that the car can follow it
provenance.plan.wall_clear_m: The reference program's development value: clearance kept between the car's envelope and every duct capsule, tape or box
provenance.plan.box_clear_m: The reference program's development value: extra clearance to a box, on top of wall_clear_m
provenance.plan.grip_window_m: The reference program's choice, as the obstacle model's reference speed: the smallest grip within +-0.3 m along the line
provenance.plan.kappa_cap_frac_of_lock: the line's curvature <= 0.95 x the full-lock curvature tan(0.4189) / 0.25784 = 1.7269 /m, i.e. <= 1.6405 /m (a measured line reached 1.90 /m at the free end of a shared wall, beyond full lock)
provenance.plan.kappa_cap_iterations, kappa_cap_spr: A design choice, first stage of the cap with the box-constrained QP: re-weight the curvature terms within +-0.5 m of every line sample above 0.995 x cap by (kappa / cap)^4 and solve again, at most 12 times; on the 80 venues of the development pool and of the rehearsal 26 of the 35 track lines above the cap kept it after 7-8 re-solves, the others moved the peak along a spine hairpin
provenance.plan.kappa_cap_penalty_*: A design choice, second stage when the first does not reach the cap: from the unweighted line, the unweighted objective plus the quadratic penalty 1000 (kbar_i - 0.98 cap)^2 on the linearised curvature averaged over +-0.2 m (then over 0 m) of a one-sided set of stations within +-0.3 m of every sample above the cap (release below 0.9 x target), at most 8 solves per averaging; on the 14 Featured venues whose spine hairpin the first stage does not settle, the cap held after one penalty solve, the model lap 0.25-0.9 % slower than the uncapped line
provenance.strategy.heat1_factor: The design: heat 1 at 0.88 of the grip-limited speed. FINAL: a factor on SPEED (every grip-dependent capability x 0.88^2); also the practice timed lap
provenance.strategy.heat2_factor: The design: heat 2 at 0.93 of the grip-limited speed. FINAL: a factor on SPEED (capabilities x 0.93^2); T_ref comes from this heat and selection gate G3 is T_ref <= 1.03 x T_qss(0.93)
provenance.strategy.avoid_factor: The reference program's choice: the avoidance test at the steady heat's factor (the design does not give one). FINAL: a factor on SPEED, 0.88; the reference's T_phase_ref of both phases are taken at it
provenance.strategy.practice_cap_mps: grader_config.json: mapping phase limit 2.0 m/s; 10 % below it
provenance.join: The reference program's development values: the join path's blend length from the car's lateral offset to its line
provenance.traffic: The reference program's development values; sep_m = car width 0.185 m + 0.265 m between the bodies (0.34 in the first gate run); abort_sep_m only logs a near miss; the slow car's speed law is the obstacle model's (others_params.json follower)
